title: Explicit scalar-extension evaluation on internal duals
statement: For an arbitrary module sheaf N on a general ringed site, construct the scalar extension map from its internal dual to the internal dual of its scalar extension. Its evaluation on s tensor f and t tensor x is st alpha(f(x)), on every slice, and it is contravariantly natural in N. Tensor generators detect equalities of these maps.

proof.text: Construct the raw balanced functional on each slice. Restriction of the sheafification unit is locally bijective, hence its Hom equivalence extends the functional uniquely. Check additivity, scalar multiplication and restriction on tensor generators. Descend in the larger internal-Hom universe and prove the evaluation and naturality formulas.

proof_origin.place: Section 03EK (section-tensor-product), Section 04TT (section-internal-hom), Lemma 03EM (lemma-internal-hom); follows the corresponding steps of lem-sp-invertible-tensor-scalar-extension
